title: SkeletonKey ToolResult envelope
description: The single return shape for every tool, in-process and on the MCP wire (as result.structuredContent, and mirrored into content[0].text for hosts that ignore structuredContent). Success and failure are the same shape, so one parser and one retry policy covers both. Serialization is bounded: over budget, `data` becomes an inlined prefix plus a spill artifact, never a truncated JSON string.

ok.description: false means: do not read `data` as an answer. It does NOT mean 'retry blindly' - read error.retryable.

tool.description: Resolved tool id, which after de-duplication may differ from the name the caller used.

run_id.description: Correlates the envelope with one line of the ledger. Quote this when reporting a bug.

data.description: The answer. On failure the engine may still attach partial data (e.g. a shell's stdout) as evidence - that is deliberate, and it is why `data` is not omitted when ok=false.

code.description: Stable machine token: SANDBOX_VIOLATION, APPROVAL_REQUIRED, MISSING_ARG, BAD_ARGS, UNKNOWN_TOOL, TIMEOUT, NONZERO_EXIT, PATCH_CONFLICT, AMBIGUOUS_MATCH, CONFLICT, EEXIST, ENOENT, READ_ONLY_MODE, DENY_RULE, BUDGET_EXCEEDED, MISSING_BINARY, MISSING_SHELL, TOOL_NOT_ADVERTISED, UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM, NOT_IMPLEMENTED, IO, INTERNAL.

message.description: One sentence, in the imperative: what to do next.

retryable.description: Safe to retry unchanged. Anything with side effects is false, even when transient.

hint.description: The single most useful follow-up action, spelled out for a model that will not read details.

details.description: Structured recovery: missing argument name, schema, minimal_example, gate.unmet + probe receipts, approval prompt, plan for a refused mutation.

path.description: Spill file holding the COMPLETE payload, inside the state dir.

fetch_rest.description: A callable fs.read that pages through this artifact. Arguments are legal values, not placeholders.

action.description: Non-call guidance, e.g. summarize_and_stop when the budget is exhausted.

next_actions.description: The tail of the turn, precomputed: paging continuation, the undo call, the approval grant to replay, the narrower search to run. A model that follows these needs no re-planning.

est_tokens.description: Charged against budget.task_max_tokens_out before the host sees the result.

provider.description: Which implementation answered (ripgrep vs built-in walker) - honest about what ran.

cached.description: Served from the idempotency cache; visible so a poll loop cannot mistake a cached answer for fresh state.

undo_available.description: Set when the tool is reversible, so 'undo' can be offered without parsing data.

context.description: Echo of what the call needed to know: cwd, task_id, and `schema` on a usage error.

warnings.description: Non-fatal truth: partial results, budget truncation notes, 'content had changed since this entry wrote it'. Warnings never fail a call, and never should be.
